# TeamShastra

> TeamShastra is field service management software for owners, managers, and technicians in India.

TeamShastra helps field service teams run jobs, attendance, customers, quotations, GST invoices, expenses, and reports from one company workspace.

## Download

- Android app (Google Play): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.teamshastra.mobile
- Android package: com.teamshastra.mobile
- Web app: https://app.teamshastra.com
- Signup: https://app.teamshastra.com/signup
- Login: https://app.teamshastra.com/login
